blocks.text: Memo: AWS capacity for weekend sales, stay on two API pods until 40 percent headroom fails

This is the working cut for LSH-MEM-2024-022 on March 7, 2024. Luis Ortega asked for a written bound after the current path (two pods, t3.large class, p95 0.42s Tuesday) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host inv-api.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on m6i.4xlarge because the graph was orange, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Stay at two API pods. Scale when p95 is over 0.9s or headroom under 22 percent on a Tuesday. Reject a jump to m6i.4xlarge because a weekend graph was orange. I am not restating a hallway yes. m6i.4xlarge because the graph was orange is out because Presidents Day p95 was 0.61s. Orange was Woo PHP, not the API. Buying the API box would not have moved pickup. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at pods=2, p95=0.42, weekend=0.61, head=34.8, thresh=22, target=0.9, weeks=1, inst=t3. Sibling tickets LSH-5211 and LSH-TST-2024-037. I will not reopen m6i.4xlarge because the graph was orange in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: woo-prod.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (37): refuse on m6i.4xlarge because the graph was orange, lock is two pods, scale on p95 0.9s or 22 percent headroom, not on orange. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-5211.
CPU looked busy. Pickup still worked. I need to know if we buy metal or if we were looking at the wrong graph.

What a skeptical user would try first on inv-api.lakeshore.internal: the path Luis Ortega actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on k8s.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
